notes: Every value below was read in this task from the source and locator given beside it. Chart values are graphical readings; their tolerance is the stated reading resolution, not a model accuracy claim.

thermally_perfect.model: NACA 1135 harmonic vibrator, gamma_perf = 1.4, Theta = 5500 degR (p. 627); temperatures in degR are converted with 1 degR = 5/9 K.

gamma_table.locator: NACA-TR-1135 p. 627, table 'Variation of ratio of specific heats with temperature' (eq. 180, Theta = 5500 degR)
gamma_table.tolerance_basis: one unit of the third printed decimal; the printed table deviates from eq. (180) by up to 6.2e-4 (largest at 3000 degR)

isentropic_charts.reading: pixel-digitized plateau; curve overlaps a grid line (0.6399 to 0.6422)

normal_shock_charts.locator: NACA-TR-1135 chart 19 (p. 671), M2 therm perf / M2 perf

cone_flow.locator: NASA-SP-3004 Table 7 (M at cone surface, p. 12), Table 9 (surface pressure coefficient, p. 14), Table 11 (shock-wave angle theta_w in radians, p. 16); gamma = 1.4; columns are nominal free-stream Mach numbers
cone_flow.tolerance_basis: Measured agreement, not a printed-digit tolerance: the largest deviations are 7.2e-6 rad (shock angle, 25 deg at M = 1.5), 2.2e-5 (Cp) and 1.6e-5 relative (surface Mach), largest at low Mach. Sims (p. 3) quotes integration error below 5e-8 and Rankine-Hugoniot residual 2e-7, so the 1e-5 offsets are not explained by the print; Table 70 confirms M_inf = 1.5000000 exactly. This library's integration is step-converged to 1e-12 and its post-shock state satisfies Sims eqs. (5)-(6) to machine precision.

anderson_figure_9_16.locator: ANDERSON-FOA-2017 Fig. 9.16, p. 635 (PDF 658): M = 2, 20 deg cone, shock angle printed as 37 deg

shock_expansion.replay_note: Anderson's worked examples read wave angles from the theta-beta-M chart (Fig. 9.9) and interpolate Appendix tables. 'replay' entries feed the printed intermediate pressure ratios to this library's force integration; 'exact' entries compare this library's exact shock-expansion result with the printed final value, with a tolerance equal to the documented effect of the chart-read inputs.
